description: This data structure represents the SGE calendar object.

attributes.name: name
description: See man page sge_calendar_conf.5 for detailed information about the attributes.

attributes.name: year_calendar
description: A year calendar as string, e.g. 12.03.2004=12-11=off.

attributes.name: week_calendar
description: A week calendar as string, e.g. mon-fri=6-20=suspended.

attributes.name: parsed_year_calendar
description: The year calendar parsed to internal data structures.

attributes.name: parsed_week_calendar
description: The week calendar parsed to internal data structures.

attributes.name: joker
description: Placeholder which can be used for arbitrary data.
Its purpose is to be able to add new attributes without changing the spooling format.
It is a list of arbitrary type and it is spooled.
